title: 📌 PM-SETU Scheme — ₹60,000 Cr ITI Upgradation & World Bank $830M Loan Facility
attentionJustification: ₹60,000 Cr scheme to upgrade 1,000 ITIs with 19.5-year World Bank facility.

constituentArticles.title: World Bank Approves $830 Million Loan for PM-SETU to Upgrade ITIs
constituentArticles.text: World Bank approved $830 million loan (19.5-year maturity, 4-year grace) under CPF 2026-31 for PM-SETU ITI upgradation.

constituentArticles.title: National Centre of Excellence for Aeronautics & Defence Skilling at NSTI Kanpur
constituentArticles.text: Centre with France announced CoE under PM-SETU (₹60,000 Cr outlay to upgrade 1,000 ITIs).
